behavior: Select the predefined demo account without entering any code or token; automatically issue a demo-only HMAC session

tests.scope: Offline demo API/session, gas ledger and architecture tests

covered: Disabled demo cannot issue a session
Unsigned, tampered, expired or wrong-secret sessions are refused
Server env secret is not returned and is no longer accepted as a direct demo Bearer
Demo session cannot authenticate operator/internal endpoints
Account selection has zero workflows, transactions or gas debits
deployment_note: Public demo mode deliberately allows visitors to share one finite sponsor allowance; all treasury security and gas checks remain required
